name: KitGuard LOCO screw_bag static counting v2 with nominal-order metric

selection.normal_pool: Official train good for development; official test good for holdout
selection.quantity_pool: Official test logical_anomalies, exactly one mask / one explicit quantity defect / counts within product scope
selection.order: Development first, holdout second; within each split alternate normal then quantity, retaining sorted order
selection.shortfall_policy: Use available eligible images only; never broaden label interpretation to fill quotas
selection.upstream_test_repartition_note: The first 8 eligible official-test quantity anomalies are explicitly reassigned to development. Remaining selected quantity anomalies form our custom holdout; this is not the untouched official-test protocol.

limitations: Report constant-222 normal images separately from variable-count anomalies; constant guessing cannot establish visual counting skill.
Original full photographs only; no crops, composites or generated images.
Count labels use author definitions and original masks, not model-generated answers or claimed human labeling.
No positive bracket examples; broad class counts do not validate screw length/SKU, actual physical recapture or unseen-factory generalization.

metric_revision.reason: Add the author's fixed normal order to expose false-ready decisions on actual quantity anomalies, including a model that always guesses 2/2/2/0
metric_revision.timing: Metric refined after reviewing 8B development results; holdout model inference had not been run when the v2 protocol was adopted
metric_revision.note: v1 and all prior development results remain preserved; this is not a claim that v2 metrics were specified before development
